0x0110.name: Model
0x0110.description: Model name or number of the equipment.

0x0112.name: Orientation
0x0112.description: The image orientation viewed in terms of rows and columns.

0x0132.name: DateTime
0x0132.description: Date and time of image modification.

0x8827.name: ISOSpeedRatings
0x8827.description: ISO speed and sensitivy of the camera.

0x9003.name: DateTimeOriginal
0x9003.description: Date and time when the original image data was generated.

0x920A.name: FocalLength
0x920A.description: Actual focal length of the lens in millimeters.

0xA002.name: ExifImageWidth
0xA002.description: Valid width of the image in pixels.

0xA003.name: ExifImageHeight
0xA003.description: Valid height of the image in pixels.

0x8825.name: GPSInfo
0x8825.description: A pointer to the GPS Info IFD block.

0x0001.name: GPSLatitudeRef
0x0001.description: Indicates whether the latitude is North or South ('N' or 'S').

0x0002.name: GPSLatitude
0x0002.description: Indicates the latitude (stored as 3 rational values: degrees, minutes, seconds).

0x0003.name: GPSLongitudeRef
0x0003.description: Indicates whether the longitude is East or West ('E' or 'W').

0x0004.name: GPSLongitude
0x0004.description: Indicates the longitude (stored as 3 rational values: degrees, minutes, seconds).

0x0005.name: GPSAltitudeRef
0x0005.description: Indicates the altitude reference (0 = Sea level, 1 = Sea level reference negative).

0x0006.name: GPSAltitude
0x0006.description: Indicates the altitude in meters above the reference.
